description: Choosing the path less traveled , every single time #selflove #growthmindset #choices
transcript: I will always choose the path less traveled because there's no traffic over there. You may run into a few roadblocks, you may run into a few other cars, you may run into people on their bikes or walking. Although the road less traveled has potholes, needs a lot of road maintenance. There are hidden secrets along the way. There are pockets and pots of gold along the way. And that is why I choose that route. I choose that route because I have the tools, I have the skills. I can create my own path. I will always make space for myself.
